name: FASW World Championship
epitaph: Held by Hellshock into Superstar Summit, April 1996, defending against Gunnar "The Grizzly" Gaines; the surviving 1996 record does not show the outcome, and the FASW's own independent run ends at this same event.

name: FASW Television Championship
epitaph: Held by Psychrobat into Superstar Summit, where a Unification Match against the EWA's own TV Champion folded it into a single belt -- the FASW's own separate lineage ends there, undefeated.
